text: FABLE REVIEW SCHEDULED (risk 4 of 6, paired with P2c). Named by the vet as THE riskiest slice of the plan: an unwritten profile format meets 23 sheets of measured hazards, and 'profile as data under the data root, never in Git' means the synthetic fixtures and the real run cannot share a profile file. Review must attack: how do fixtures and the real profile stay in step, and does the in-memory-ArtifactStore falsifier actually bind open to the snapshot?
